description: Source-backed starter protocols for sensitive legacy Growth Zones. A reviewed status applies only to the bounded public protocol and its stated evidence boundary; it does not validate the entire legacy therapy or professional collection.

abdominal-breathing-stress-relief.note: Reviewed against current NCCIH relaxation guidance. Public copy is limited to comfortable diaphragmatic breathing as a general relaxation exercise, removes fixed-rate and treatment claims, and explicitly says not to replace conventional care.

cbt-action-mood-tracker.note: Reviewed against NHS CBT and thought-record guidance. Public copy is an educational observation worksheet about situation, action and before/after experience; it is not presented as formal CBT, diagnosis, treatment, or proof of causality.

cardio-health-daily-habits.note: Reviewed against American Heart Association physical-activity guidance. Public copy is narrowed to planning movement toward the adult weekly activity baseline, with explicit adaptation to ability and professional medical advice.

daily-gratitude-journal-three-things.note: Reviewed against recent gratitude meta-analysis and systematic-review evidence. Public copy preserves the small/variable-effect boundary, removes fixed dosage and guaranteed mood claims, and says not to force gratitude or substitute it for mental-health care.

abdominal-breathing-stress-relief.reason: The reviewed protocol is a conservative body-focused relaxation exercise for everyday stress. Stress Regulation is the concrete Topic; Body-oriented remains a sensitive Method classification rather than an efficacy claim for body-oriented therapy.

cbt-action-mood-tracker.reason: The reviewed protocol records situation, action and observed before/after state. Self-Awareness and Emotion Regulation are the concrete Topics; CBT-derived identifies the source tradition with an explicit non-therapy boundary.

cardio-health-daily-habits.reason: The reviewed protocol is general cardiovascular-health activity planning grounded in AHA guidance. Cardiovascular Health, Movement and Everyday Health Basics describe the bounded public use.

daily-gratitude-journal-three-things.reason: The reviewed protocol is an optional gratitude reflection with modest-evidence boundaries. Mood & Wellbeing and Self-Awareness describe the concrete use; Positive Psychotherapy-derived remains a sensitive Method label, not a claim that this page provides psychotherapy.
